|strategy=Vigos are the lieutenants in the Black Sun criminal organization. When not engaged in controlling their small sector of the Black Sun Empire, a [[Vigo]] spends its time squabbling with other Vigos and jockeying for power. The Vigos report to and are kept in check by [[Prince Xizor]].
